deadline.value: International applicants for September 2027 must apply by February 28, 2027 (domestic: July 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field; McMaster Engineering does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: PhD students must have a supervisor; faculty see all complete applications, but you are expected to reach out to them yourself.
supervisor.quote: Yes, M.A.Sc and Ph.D students need to have a supervisor. | it is necessary that you reach out to them yourself

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are funded for 48 months through scholarships and/or TAships.
funding.quote: Full time PhD students receive funding from the department/supervisor in the form of scholarships and/or teaching assistantships (funding is for 48 months).

entry_route.value: A master's in a related field is required; bachelor's holders start in the MASc and strong students may transfer.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the program from a Bachelor's degree are expected to begin at the Master's level.

gre_general.value: McMaster Engineering does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: No. McMaster Engineering does not require a GRE score.

toefl_min.value: The Faculty of Engineering requires TOEFL iBT 88 with at least 20 per band.
toefl_min.quote: Faculty of Engineering a minimum score of 88 (internet-based, iBT or iBT Home Edition); minimum of 20 per band.

english_waiver.value: Engineering exempts applicants whose university degree was taught in English from the English test.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have completed a university degree where the official language of instruction is English, do not need to submit a language proficiency test.

notes: Joint school of the Faculties of Engineering and Health Sciences.
